flags: Road-construction and designation history is limited: the cache gives no byway campaign or designation date. The history paragraph uses the documented arrival of pavement at Truchas and the older mountain-road connection at Las Trampas.

Length and scope conflict: tourism describes 105 miles from Santa Fe; the route article describes 56 miles beginning at Pojoaque. Omitted mileage and drive time. The NMDOT dataset is truncated, though High Road records survive.
Moments follow the northbound narrative, decreasing strip-map miles from Chimayó through Truchas and Las Trampas to Ranchos de Taos.
Corrected current wording suggesting the entire Las Trampas grant is national forest: the land-grant history specifies former common lands.
San Francisco de Asís completion dates disagree within the cache (1815 versus 1816); omitted exact construction dates. Santuario is complete by 1816, not necessarily built entirely in 1816.
No tribal-authored history is cached. Avoided inherited generalized conflict narratives and sacred-origin legends. No interior access schedule or participation in religious practices is promised.
